limitations: EV-0063 is captured before root staging and intentionally excludes the final CP-0027 checkpoint/current/evidence hashes, final root tree, and final root commit to avoid a hash cycle. Its prepare journal copy is historical once prepare-root mutates the live journal.
The accepted OpenCL execution is restricted to the exact 5160-byte gfx950 vecadd image, 88-byte kernarg, 1024/256 launch, three buffers, and one dispatch per context/session.
The manifest's freshly compiled gpuReadWrite image is provenance-only and not accepted by the CP26 daemon lock; the separate locked gpuReadWrite image is used only for CP26 regressions.

Reusable multi-dispatch/events, arbitrary OpenCL images/shapes, normal Triton Python driver/runtime, the model operator matrix, full model inference, stable multi-token decode, TP, and CCL are not implemented or claimed.

The retained 0.9-second-class wall times and gem5 host time are diagnostic observations, not performance guarantees. Profiling and optimization were deferred because correctness expansion is not blocked.

The failed or stale pre-v5 prefix run is explicitly excluded from acceptance. No EV-0063 command or external artifact treats that run as passing; only the final v5 sim-named prefix and its successful captures are authoritative.
